title: Past continuous
function: Describe actions in progress in the past

sections.heading: What is the Past Continuous?
sections.body: The Past Continuous describes an action that was in progress at a specific moment in the past. It is often used together with the Past Simple to show an interruption.

sections.heading: Negative and questions
list: Negative: was not / were not + verb-ing. I was not sleeping.
Question: Was/Were + subject + verb-ing? Were you listening?
Short answers: Yes, I was. / No, I wasn't.

sections.heading: Past Continuous vs Past Simple
sections.body: Past Continuous = background action in progress. Past Simple = short action or interruption.
table: I was walking home when I saw an old friend.

sections.heading: When and while
list: When + Past Simple: I was reading when the phone rang.
While + Past Continuous: While I was reading, the phone rang.
Two actions at the same time: I was cooking while she was watching TV.

sections.heading: Time expressions
list: at 8 pm yesterday, at that moment
this time last week
while, when, as

sections.heading: Common mistakes
list: Do not forget 'was/were': 'I reading' is wrong. Say 'I was reading'.
Do not use Past Continuous for short finished actions. Use Past Simple.
Remember: he/she/it + was; you/we/they + were.

list.definition: I was walking to school at 8 am.
They were studying for the exam.
He was talking on the phone.
I was reading when the phone rang.
We were having dinner when someone knocked.
She was studying when the lights went out.
I was walking home when I saw an accident.
We were playing when it started to rain.
The sun was shining and birds were singing.
People were walking in the park.
Children were playing in the garden.
Music was playing in the background.
It was getting dark when we arrived.

phases.name: Discovery
phases.intro: Look at these sentences. Read them carefully and think about the questions below.
sentences: I was walking home when I saw an old friend.
She was reading a book at 8 pm yesterday.
They were playing football while we were watching TV.
The phone rang while I was having dinner.
What were you doing at 10 pm?
It was raining when we left the house.
We were not sleeping when you called.
The children were playing in the garden.
questions: In sentences 1 and 2, which tense describes an action in progress?
In sentence 1, which tense describes the interruption?
In sentence 3, why are both parts in Past Continuous?
In sentence 4, which part is the interruption and which is the background?
In sentence 5, how do we make a question in Past Continuous?
In sentence 7, how do we make the negative?

questions.prompt: I ___ TV when the phone rang.
She ___ a book at 8 pm yesterday.
questions.explanation: Action in progress at a specific time in the past.

questions.prompt: They ___ football while we were watching TV.
questions.explanation: Two simultaneous actions use Past Continuous.

questions.prompt: The phone ___ while I was having dinner.
What ___ you doing at 10 pm?
It ___ when we left the house.
We ___ sleeping when you called.
The children ___ in the garden.
I ___ reading when the lights went out.
While she ___, the doorbell rang.
questions.explanation: After 'while' we often use Past Continuous.

phases.name: Free practice
prompts: Describe what you were doing yesterday at 8 am, 1 pm, 6 pm and 10 pm. Use Past Continuous.
Write a short story (5 sentences) about an interruption. Use Past Continuous and Past Simple.
Describe a scene from a photo or memory using at least 5 sentences in Past Continuous.

They ___ tennis at 5 pm yesterday.
questions.explanation: Action in progress at a specific time.

questions.prompt: She ___ TV when the lights went out.

It ___ heavily when we arrived.
While I ___, the phone rang.
We ___ studying when the teacher came in.
He ___ sleeping at midnight.

I ___ walking home when I saw the accident.

sections.heading: Key rules
list: Past Continuous: was / were + verb-ing.
Use it for actions in progress at a specific moment in the past.
Past Simple for interruptions.
While + Past Continuous; When + Past Simple.
Negative: was not / were not + verb-ing.
Question: Was/Were + subject + verb-ing?

sections.heading: Common mistakes
list: Forgetting 'was/were': 'I reading' is wrong.
Using Past Continuous for short finished actions.
Mixing up was and were with the wrong subject.

sections.heading: Useful phrases
list: I was ...-ing when ...
While I was ...-ing, ...
At 8 pm yesterday I was ...
What were you doing...?
The sun was shining...
It was raining...
